sections.title: Two-minute cockpit
sections.text: Tracera is an original owned project, with accepted unified intent: local-first trace/session linking, memory distillation and audit replay plus persistent product modelling and discrepancy discovery. Q1 delivered a real durable product-observation API, detector identity corrections, SQLite/PostgreSQL atomicity and a restart/replay runtime journey. Full unified CVP and real user acceptance remain unproved. Source PR1157 is open; no merge or production promotion.

Registry at05e1638 defines local-first trace/session dependency reasoning, memory distillation and audit replay. Its CVP also includes desktop. docs5 explicitly calls its persistent product-model program proposed; it is not authority to erase Registry identity.
